items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025
items.q: So the president, his name was Perry Gray, he was a shrewd guy you know.

ctx.x: I see. That’s a great story.

And it was a great thing because they said listen this segregation thing is not going to last and when they merge the other union is going to come in and they’re going to swallow up all your assets, including your real estate. And so when it came the president of the old union, they actually came over and asked for the key you know. Yeah.
